description: This file contains utility functions and core logic for handling form submissions, including webhook and email notifications, response processing, and related workflows within a routing forms module.

methods.name: normalizeIdentifierForHandlebars
methods.description: Replaces spaces in an identifier with hyphens for use in Handlebars templates.

methods.name: isOptionsField
methods.description: Checks if a form field is of type 'select' or 'multiselect' and has options.

methods.name: getFieldResponse
methods.description: Processes a form field response to include label and id information, handling options fields.

methods.name: sendResponseEmail
methods.description: Sends an email with form responses, dynamically importing email template if in server environment.

methods.name: getWebhookTargetEntity
methods.description: Determines whether the webhook target is a user or team based on form data.

methods.name: _onFormSubmission
methods.description: Main function handling form submission logic: webhooks, emails, workflows, and fallback actions.

methods.name: onFormSubmission
methods.description: Wrapped version of _onFormSubmission with reporting capabilities.

methods.name: onSubmissionOfFormResponse
methods.description: Wrapper that prepares data and calls onFormSubmission for a specific form response.
